title: XTi has built Java and open-source custom software since 2001, making it OSS-native
content:
XTi has delivered Java and open-source custom development since 2001, which the record summarises as OSS-native, and it is dual-certified: Camunda Silver and Flowable Strategic. It operates from three Belgian locations — Kontich, Hasselt and Merelbeke — and is carried at priority 2.

The reason the track record matters more than the certifications is that open-source posture is the criterion the screen most often cannot evidence. Elsewhere in the same sweep the instruction is to run an OSS-portfolio screen before acting, precisely because a platform certification says nothing about whether a firm would build on client-owned, open infrastructure. A quarter-century of open-source custom delivery answers that question from history rather than from a positioning statement, which is stronger evidence than any partner tier.

The dual certification then adds the practical seam: both Camunda and Flowable are orchestration engines that decide when things happen while holding the running instance as mutable, purgeable state, so both leave the append-only decision record unowned. A firm certified on both has the same gap twice, and the integration built for one applies to the other. Provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder mined on 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
